summary: Revised comprehensive optimization plan for Astrovia incorporating pressure-sensitive micro-haptics (@capacitor/haptics), premium slider overhauls with tactile ticks, an expanded compact liquid-glass shortcuts grid on the home screen (Panchang, Monthly Calendar, Lagna Chart, Horoscope, Matching, Reports, Decision Muhurat, Acharya), along with device-local SWR caching and DOM-retained zero-latency tab transitions.
